description: flash_mla_sparse_decode_fp8 shapes of the AgentX agentic serving corpus replayed on deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark (TP 4); each performance case is weighted by how often its shapes run (calls per second of the steady state) and the task scores the ratio of total times. The task's earlier shapes and the boundary shapes are correctness-only.

weight_provenance.weight_unit: calls per second of the steady state, TP rank 0
weight_provenance.description: device time of TP rank 0: decode kernels from the eager leg's profiler windows, prefill kernels from every leg's windows, each phase scaled to the graph leg's logged steady-state step count; image lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.23-rocm720-mi35x-20261109; matcher flash_mla_sparse_decode_fp8; decode shapes padded to captured CUDA-graph batch sizes.

deployment.server_env: SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 SGLANG_USE_ROCM700A=0 TRITON_HIP_USE_ASYNC_COPY=0 ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT8 SGLANG_OPT_HIP_OPUS_SPARSE_PREFILL=true SGLANG_OPT_HIP_FLYDSL_MXFP8=1 SGLANG_HIP_FP4_INDEXER_ROWGROUP=1 TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_HIPBLASLT=1 HSA_NO_SCRATCH_RECLAIM=0 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 AITER_BF16_FP8_MOE_BOUND=0
